summary: Over Labor Day weekend Saguache SAR was activated four times; at post time a team was deployed in the western part of the county searching for a missing 77-year-old female. No resolution reported in this pull.
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page. Date approximate: post dated 2023-09-04 said a team was 'currently' deployed; listed as 2023-09-03. Outcome unknown.
